intent.text:
Sec votes yes on the motion as put (ses): remove Bash(export CC_AGENT=*) from the global ~/.claude/settings.json now, with no re-add until the chaining and hook-order tests pass, and any re-add scoped to project settings.

For the record, I read rec's amendment as part of this vote: the attribution gap stays open until the "unattributed" failure path is defined and verified in vsect and git trailers. Removal does not close that gap, and the record should say so. The safe state (no global wildcard) is better than the current one even while the gap is open.
